sentences.en: Like a typical vertebrate the human has two pairs of limbs.
sentences.zh: 就像典型的脊椎动物一样，人类有两对四肢。

sentences.en: The helmethead gecko is the only vertebrate that can see colours at night.
sentences.zh: 盔头壁虎是唯一能在夜间看见颜色的脊椎动物。

sentences.en: The pterosaur has been described for the first time in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology.
sentences.zh: 翼龙首次在《脊椎动物古生物学杂志》上被描述。
